blocks.text: Add rustic charm and everyday comfort to your kitchen island or home bar with the Moriville Upholstered Bar Stool. Crafted from durable wood with a distressed nutmeg finish, this stool blends farmhouse character with timeless appeal. The cushioned seat is wrapped in textured polyester upholstery for a soft, inviting feel, while antiqued nailhead trim in a bronze-tone finish adds a refined detail. Perfect for casual dining or entertaining, this bar stool offers a comfortable spot for lingering over meals or enjoying conversation. Its versatile design complements a variety of decor styles, making it an ideal choice for counter-height seating in kitchens, dining areas or open-concept spaces. Assembly required.

items.label: UPHOLSTERED BARSTOOLS
items.value: You'll fall in love with the cool, vintage-inspired details. Bathed in a natural wood hue and dressed up with soft beige upholstery, these bar stools are a treat for the senses

items.label: HANDSOMELY CRAFTED
items.value: Bar stool chairs are made of wood with cozy polyester upholstery. Adorned with antiqued bronze-tone accents

items.label: CHARMING DETAILS
items.value: The subtle weathered treatment and antiqued nailhead trim punctuate these chairs with old world character

items.label: SET OF 2
items.value: Place these by a high dining table or at the kitchen bar. Each counter height barstool chair measures 19.25” W x 23.5” D x 41.25” H

items.label: ASSEMBLY REQUIRED
items.value: Easy-to-follow instructions and hardware included. Screwdriver (not included) is needed for full assembly
